<title level="1" right="Hazard 9" pfs="">[Caustic Gas Trap](/Hazards.aspx?ID=412)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Mechanical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=105" />
<trait label="Trap" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=158" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown](/Sources.aspx?ID=210) pg. 37

**Complexity** Simple

</column>

Pressure plates in the hall trigger the release of caustic gas.

---

**Stealth**
DC 30 (master)

**Disable**
DC 28 [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) (master) to neutralize the acid or DC 30 [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) (master) to disable the pressure plates

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Collapse** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** A creature in contact with the ground travels down this hall; **Effect** Caustic gas fills the hall, dealing 4d10+26 acid damage to all creatures in area D5 (DC 32 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save).

---
**Reset**
A 10-minute Interact activity and a new supply of caustic gas.
